root_causes.root_cause: _inject_arabic_structural_headings (RFC-028 D1) removed prev_blank guard and raised char limit to 100, which injects just enough headings for shallow Arabic docs to clear validate_tree thresholds (node_count>=3, depth>=2) — preventing the flat fallback path from triggering. The tree stores a thin 6-node/1225-char result instead of the richer 75-block/5972-char flat extraction. Additionally, for docs where ALL articles have flat peer numbering (1,2,3 not 1.1,1.2), _relevel_by_containment cannot build deeper hierarchy, and _relevel_by_numbering only assigns depth based on numbering_depth which maps all articles to the same level.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add a content-density comparison gate: when the tree from md_to_tree passes validate_tree but the flat extraction would yield significantly more content (e.g. flat_char_count > 3x tree_char_count), prefer the flat result. Alternatively, add a minimum chars-per-node threshold to validate_tree so a 6-node/1225-char tree (204 chars/node) does not pass when the content is demonstrably thin. This addresses the regression (marsoom 13) and the stalls (qerar 1, qerar 106) where a barely-passing tree blocks richer flat extraction.

root_causes.root_cause: route_and_extract_flat has no fence-marker or HR-separator filtering. Markdown fence delimiters (```) and horizontal rules (---) produced by Docling fall through to the prose accumulator (line 2357-2359) and become noise prose blocks. For docs routed to the flat path, 15-20% of blocks are these parsing artifacts. The _pre_inference_normalize chain and _inject_arabic_structural_headings run before md_to_tree but do not strip fences/HRs, and the flat extractor has no special handling for them.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add fence-marker and HR-separator detection at the top of the route_and_extract_flat while loop: (1) skip lines matching ^```.*$ (fence delimiters) and toggle an in_fence state to skip content inside fences, (2) skip lines matching ^---+$ or ^===+$ or ^\*\*\*+$ (thematic breaks/HR separators). Also add a pre-processing strip in the markdown normalization chain (before md_to_tree) to remove or neutralize fences and HRs that Docling emits.
